correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the \(8\)-vertex, \(24\)-edge, \(16\)-face complex from the stated facets. Exact mod-two reduction gives face-equation rank \(15\) and coboundary rank \(7\), hence \(H^1(K;\mathbf F_2)\cong\mathbf F_2^2\). The checker exhausts all \(512\) cocycles, all four cohomology classes, all support weights, and the cup square on every representative. It obtains exactly \((w,m,q)=(5,1,1),(6,5,0),(6,3,1)\), verifies the unique weight-five support, and confirms every minimizer is one simple dual cycle.

value.rationale: The mod-two one-cosystole is a natural discrete systolic/cohomological-code invariant of a canonical vertex-minimal Klein-bottle triangulation. The complete profile distinguishes all three nonzero classes by minimum dual-cycle length, minimizer multiplicity, and cup-square type: \((5,1,1),(6,5,0),(6,3,1)\). This class-dependent structure is not determined by the abstract cohomology group or known asymmetry and supplies a reusable exact benchmark for discrete surface cohomology.
